The potential impact of this documentary is likely to be significant within the fields of environmental science, animal ethics, and consumer behavior. By exposing the harsh realities of factory farming, the film serves as a powerful catalyst for shifting public opinion. It may lead to a measurable decrease in demand for factory-farmed products as consumers become more aware of the environmental degradation and animal welfare issues associated with industrial agriculture. Concurrently, it is expected to boost interest in vegan and cruelty-free alternatives, potentially accelerating market growth for plant-based and lab-grown meat products. This shift could also influence policy discussions, prompting greater scrutiny of agricultural subsidies and regulations related to animal welfare and environmental sustainability.
